dct_creator_sm: Centre for Sustainable Food Systems at UBC Farm ((Faculty of Land and Food Systems, University of British Columbia), Faculty of Land and Food Systems, University of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains PDFs of UBC Farm annual field maps since 2015, including relative field locations and sizes, field codes, crop rotation groups, and infrastructure types. Please note that these maps are used for field planning purposes only, and the actual crops grown in fields may differ from the rotation groups provided here. The best uses of these maps are: 1) to determine locations of field codes in other UBC Farm datasets; 2) to look up field codes for UBC Farm research projects, and 3) to understand the general layout of the Farm.
